description: Start connecting the agent in this codebase, in one call: takes the project the user named (number or name), or with none named creates one named after the codebase when the account has no project, and otherwise lists the projects so you can ask the user which. Makes it the default project, writes the project key and traces address into .env (values never returned; says whether git ignores the file), and returns the setup steps (the connect skill) to follow next.

file.description: The env file, inside this workspace.

project.description: The project's number or name, as the user gave it.
